name: @kickside/knowledge-ui
title: KickSide Knowledge
description: Knowledge bases control page web component for kickside/knowledge, over the native KB CRUD/browse/search API.

wippy.description: Builds four web components from one package (per-tag registry entries live in src/_index.yaml): the primary tag kickside-knowledge (index.js) — the Knowledge surface that lists knowledge bases and opens a detail view mounting the KB engine's own component — plus wc-kb-picker (picker.js), the reusable knowledge configuration element, kx-kb-create-dialog (kb_create.js), the standalone create-KB dialog, and kickside-onboard-knowledge (onboard.js), the onboarding wizard step. The surface accepts a 'route' attribute (the sub-path under /knowledge: empty for the list, '<kbId>' or '<kbId>/<nodeId>' for deep links) and emits 'navigate' with the new sub-path for the shell to reflect into the URL. wc-kb-picker receives config { kb_ids: string[] } for multi-base trait scopes, or a schema declaring kb_id for one embed-sink destination; it emits 'config-changed' with that matching key. kx-kb-create-dialog accepts a 'parent-id' attribute and emits 'created' and 'close'; the onboarding element emits 'done' and 'back' to drive the host wizard. The props block below describes the primary kickside-knowledge tag, and the events block covers the surface's 'navigate' plus the picker's 'config-changed'; the other tags' schemas are declared in their own registry entries.

route.description: Deep-link sub-path under /knowledge: a kb id, optionally followed by an in-KB node path (kbId/nodeId).

config-changed.description: Emitted by wc-kb-picker with kb_ids for trait scopes or kb_id when the supplied schema declares a single embed-sink destination.

navigate.description: Emitted to update the URL to the in-surface location (the sub-path under /knowledge).
